$note: Site logistics story of the Ludwigsburg school. The site lies beside a running school: pupils' path and site fence are separate, vehicle movements keep clear of school start, breaks and end, one crane serves the structure. All names are invented.

gates.name: Gate 1 - delivery road west
gates.note: Only construction gate for heavy vehicles. Banksman on duty. Pupils use the fenced path on the east side, never this road.

gates.name: Gate 2 - sports hall side
gates.note: Rigid vehicles only, used for the sports hall and kitchen wing. Closed whenever pupils are in the yard next to it.

zones.name: Laydown A - west field
zones.note: Reinforcement and formwork. Behind the hoarding, inside the tower crane radius, out of sight of the yard.

zones.name: Laydown B - timber facade store
zones.note: Covered storage for prefabricated timber facade elements. Dry, no stacking above 3 m.

area_names.A-BLD: School, sports hall and Mensa footprint

power_connection_point: Transformer kiosk at the west gate, outside the pupils' area
water_consumer: Concrete curing, dust suppression and wheel wash

strategy.description: Reinforcement, cut and bent, delivered by slab
Prefabricated timber facade elements, stored dry
Precast stair cores, set from the truck outside pupil arrival and departure

rules_text.en: Book every delivery 48 hours ahead with the site manager, who clears the slot with the school office. No vehicle movements during pupil arrival (07:30 to 08:00) or departure (15:00 to 16:00), and none on the yard side during breaks. No waiting on the public road. Wheel wash on exit.
rules_text.de: Jede Anlieferung 48 Stunden vorher bei der Bauleitung anmelden, die das Zeitfenster mit dem Schulsekretariat abstimmt. Keine Fahrbewegungen zu Schulbeginn (07:30 bis 08:00) und Schulende (15:00 bis 16:00), keine auf der Hofseite in den Pausen. Kein Warten auf der oeffentlichen Strasse. Radwaesche bei der Ausfahrt.

municipality_contact: City of Ludwigsburg, building control office (Baurechtsamt)
parking_note: No site parking on the school grounds or in the residential streets. Site staff use the leased lot at the sports ground, with a shuttle at 07:00 and 16:30.
heavy_title: Transformer for the campus supply 62 t
heavy_route_notes: Ring road, then the delivery road from the west. Escort stops traffic at the school crossing; no passage during pupil arrival and departure, night move only.
oversize_authority: Road traffic authority of the city
spoil_title: Excavated soil to the licensed tip, outside school start and end
rebar_title: Reinforcement, ground floor slab of the classroom wing
dust_description: Dust on the windows of the existing school building and on parked cars after excavation.
dust_response: Water spraying twice a day, wheel wash at the gate, school windows on the site side kept shut during earthworks.
noise_description: Reversing alarms before school start at the delivery gate, reported by the head teacher.

coordination.topic: Crane position and road occupation at the delivery road
coordination.outcome: Agreed in principle with the building control office; written application for the road occupation to follow.

coordination.topic: Separate pupils' path and site fence, school start and break plan
coordination.outcome: Head teacher and parents' council informed; path along the east side marked and fenced before the first delivery.
Utility confirmed the connection in four weeks.
